parts.name: Leg (Left Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, made of lightweight plastic. It is a long, thin component extending from the frame to the ear.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the eyeglasses on the wearer’s ear and helps maintain stability and comfort during use.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around the hinge joint connecting it to the base body, allowing folding and unfolding for storage and wearing.

parts.name: Leg (Right Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, made of plastic. It mirrors the left leg in shape and function.
parts.Functional_description: It provides balance and support on the opposite side of the head, ensuring the eyeglasses stay in place.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its hinge joint for folding and unfolding, similar to the left leg.

parts.name: Base Body (Frame and Lenses)
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the eyeglasses, including the frame and lenses, made of polycarbonate for durability and optical clarity.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the lenses in place and provides the primary optical function of vision correction or protection.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the central structure to which the legs are attached via hinges.
